statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6225 affects the unmaintained github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env module (no fixed release). Kubescape v4.0.12 pulls it in indirectly through helm.sh/helm/v3. Replacing it with github.com/gaganhr94/docker-credential-acr@v1.0.2 via go mod replace fails because helm also resolves the maintained module directly, producing a dual module-path conflict at go mod tidy. Until helm upstream drops the legacy import or kubescape can adopt a release that no longer needs it, the finding remains visible on v4 variants.

GO-2026-6225 affects github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env, which has no fixed module release. The module is linked into the docker-scout CLI plugin through sigstore/cosign registry keychain support. Replacing it requires upstream cosign to migrate off the unmaintained chrismellard helper to a maintained fork with compatible import paths.
